title: Schemas, validating the response and repairing invalid output

videos.script: Lesson 18 asked a parser one question: is this JSON at all? {{parse}} A reply can pass that and still be useless. The category is a word nobody listed. The refund says yes, as a string. A field is missing. {{useless}} A schema is a written description of the object you expect, and a program can check a reply against it. {{schema}} Every problem comes back with the field it is about, so the fix can be precise. {{paths}} Then you repair. A reply wrapped in a sentence and a code fence is cut out and checked. A reply that is wrong is sent back, once or twice, with the errors in it. {{repair}} And never in an endless loop. {{limit}} Last comes the check no schema makes. A refund can be the right type and the wrong amount. {{meaning}} The café's own rules decide that, and you write them down too. {{rules}}
